automation_requirements.statement: Replace catalog fixtures with the Applications API registry projection, including installed, marketplace, and development sources, search, filters, pagination, icons, and explicit unavailable states.
automation_requirements.acceptance: Applications.list returns the complete bounded registry view; UI paging and filters preserve selection and show API failures without falling back to prototype fixtures.

disclosure.en: Catalog data is simulated until Automation connects the Applications API.
disclosure.ru: Данные каталога смоделированы до подключения Applications API на этапе автоматизации.

automation_requirements.statement: Bind selected Application details, releases, operations, development reports, update assessment, setup state, and health to the Application API.
automation_requirements.acceptance: Selection triggers bounded API reads with revision-aware state; switching Applications cannot display stale detail from the previous selection.

disclosure.en: Detail and health records are representative Prototype data.
disclosure.ru: Детали и состояние представлены демонстрационными данными прототипа.

automation_requirements.statement: Implement install, update, update-track settings, remove, pinning, and reviewed apply through Applications plan/apply contracts with idempotency and optimistic revision checks.
automation_requirements.acceptance: Every consequential lifecycle action creates and displays a reviewable plan, applies the exact digest once, handles revision conflicts, and never mutates shadow UI state as authority.

disclosure.en: Lifecycle actions are visual simulations until Automation.
disclosure.ru: Действия жизненного цикла являются визуальной симуляцией до автоматизации.

automation_requirements.statement: Bind Permissions, Access, Roles, Connected accounts, release readiness, privacy, simulation, and audit activity to the Applications access API.
automation_requirements.acceptance: Reads are release-bound; grant/change/revoke and connected-account writes use subject selectors, idempotency, and CAS; compact access forms remain scrollable.

disclosure.en: Access records and writes are simulated in this Prototype.
disclosure.ru: Записи и изменения доступа смоделированы в этом прототипе.

automation_requirements.statement: Integrate setup contracts, credential handoff, runtime placement, relocation review, conditions, and component uninstall with the Applications API without exposing secrets.
automation_requirements.acceptance: Setup and placement use purpose-bound API contracts, redact credential values, enforce expected revisions, and show recoverable failure states.

disclosure.en: Setup, credentials, and placement are representative until Automation.
disclosure.ru: Настройка, учетные данные и размещение представлены демонстрационно до автоматизации.

automation_requirements.statement: Expose exact Builder Prototype, Automation, Trial beta, and stable lifecycle state and actions for locally developed Applications.
automation_requirements.acceptance: Open Preview/Open in Builder target the selected development; beta opens the accepted Trial; stable actions appear only after publication evidence.

disclosure.en: Builder lifecycle values are Prototype examples until Automation records a Trial.
disclosure.ru: Состояния Builder являются примерами до создания Trial на этапе автоматизации.

automation_requirements.statement: Run contract, API, wide, compact, access, failure, idempotency, and publication-gate validation for Applications beta.
automation_requirements.acceptance: Focused tests and browser E2E pass without page/API errors; every linked Development Ticket receives exact Automation and Trial evidence or an explicit unresolved blocker.

disclosure.en: Beta readiness is pending Automation and Trial evidence.
disclosure.ru: Готовность beta ожидает доказательств Automation и Trial.
